NamaSpace prototype
Dataset: Tanks and Temples - Meetingroom.
Creators: Arno Knapitsch, Jaesik Park, Qian-Yi Zhou and Vladlen Koltun (2017).
Source: https://www.tanksandtemples.org/download/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated in the Copyright section of https://www.tanksandtemples.org/license/
License link: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes by NamaSpace: extracted and resized video frames; estimated camera poses and sparse geometry with COLMAP; trained a Gaussian Splatting reconstruction; exported a compact base-colour model and split it into browser assets. Test data is a resized 24-frame subset with embedded metadata removed.
The dataset authors do not endorse or sponsor this project. Source data and derived benchmark assets retain the applicable attribution and license notices; no additional restrictions are imposed by NamaSpace.
The source license page also contains conflicting restrictions; this attribution relies on its express CC BY 4.0 statement and does not resolve that inconsistency.
Living-room scene: project owner's smartphone capture, not Tanks and Temples data.
Training: gsplat 1.5.3 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/gsplat
The compact viewer model retains base colour only.
